mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (-4614, 18527) and has to end up at (-22571, 4558). On the way it must stop at A (Long Reef Helipad) at (14797, 17878), B (Royal North Shore Hospital Helipad) at (3878, 8760), C (Westmead - Children's Hospital Helipad) at (-14429, 10859), D (Wanda Beach Helipad) at (1246, -15622); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Sydney Kingsford Smith International Airport (YSSY, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Sydney Bankstown Airport (YSBK, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 125457 meters. The battery only allows 131448 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is Sydney Adventist Hospital Helipad; DEST is Fairfield Hospital Helipad.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
